temperature.source: the design's range: an indoor cabinet beside the fire panel, 0 to 50 C (README, Board)

tolerance.source: the parts list: 1 % thick-film resistors, 10 % X7R capacitors; REOL is the installer's 5 % end-of-line resistor; VDD is +3V3 within the 3 % the firmware allows for U2; ILOOP is the feed's 16.5 to 27.5 mA (0.55 to 0.75 V across R18, 27 ohm)
